arguments.name: ecaTypeCode
arguments.description: The activity type code to identify the record to edit (e.g., "000001"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

raw.name: ecaTypeCode
raw.description: The activity type code to identify the record to edit (e.g., "000001"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

arguments.name: ecaTypeName
arguments.description: The activity type name to identify the record to edit (e.g., "Learning"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

raw.name: ecaTypeName
raw.description: The activity type name to identify the record to edit (e.g., "Learning"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

arguments.name: newTypeName
arguments.description: The new name for the activity type. If not provided, the type name will remain unchanged. Maximum 120 characters.

raw.name: newTypeName
raw.description: The new name for the activity type. If not provided, the type name will remain unchanged. Maximum 120 characters.

arguments.name: newCategoryCode
